title: Chocolate protein chia pudding
description: Chia seeds soaked in chocolate protein milk until thick and spoonable.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Cost stays incomplete until the protein powder's price is entered.

steps.text: Set out 2 jars with lids and measure the milk, protein powder and cocoa.
Whisk the protein powder and cocoa into the milk until smooth, then whisk in the vanilla.
Stir in the chia seeds, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up any clumps.
Divide between the 2 jars, seal and chill at least 2 hours, or overnight, until thick.
Keep the jars sealed in the fridge.
